questions.en: What is the traditional main ingredient of Japanese yakitori skewers?

timeline.labelEn: Hotei Foods becomes the first company to sell canned yakitori
timeline.labelDe: Hotei Foods verkauft als erstes Unternehmen Yakitori in der Dose

questions.notes: Traditional yakitori consists only of chicken parts and vegetables. Timeline date from the English Wikipedia article Yakitori.

questions.cardDe: Die erste Radiosendung in Deutschland war die Live-Übertragung einer Aufführung von Goethes Faust. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welches Musikstück wurde am 29. Oktober 1923 in der ersten Radiosendung in Deutschland live als Cello-Solo übertragen?
questions.en: Which piece of music was broadcast live as a cello solo in Germany's first radio broadcast on 29 October 1923?

timeline.labelEn: Funk-Stunde Berlin starts regular radio broadcasting from the Vox-Haus, Berlin
timeline.labelDe: Die Funk-Stunde Berlin beginnt im Berliner Vox-Haus den regelmäßigen Rundfunk-Sendebetrieb

questions.notes: The card's statement is false. The first piece broadcast was Kreisler's 'Andantino in the style of Martini', a cello solo with piano played by Otto Urack and Fritz Goldschmidt.

questions.cardDe: Was war das erste Nahrungsmittel, das auf dem Mond gegessen wurde: ein Mars-Riegel, eine Hostie oder ein Erdnussbuttersandwich?
questions.de: Was war das erste Nahrungsmittel, das auf dem Mond gegessen wurde?
questions.en: What was the first food eaten on the Moon?

timeline.labelEn: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon; Buzz Aldrin privately takes communion
timeline.labelDe: Apollo 11 landet auf dem Mond; Buzz Aldrin nimmt privat das Abendmahl

questions.notes: Aldrin took communion with a kit from his pastor; the bread and wine were the first food and liquid consumed on the Moon.

timeline.labelDe: Suzanne Collins veröffentlicht „Die Tribute von Panem“, den ersten Panem-Roman

source.title: Kieran Culkin appelliert an Fans der Panem-Reihe – Filmstarts

questions.en: Which vehicle was nicknamed 'Taigatrommel' ('taiga drum') in East Germany because of its loud exhaust?

timeline.labelEn: East Germany's Deutsche Reichsbahn starts receiving Soviet M62 diesel locomotives
timeline.labelDe: Die Deutsche Reichsbahn der DDR erhält erste sowjetische Dieselloks der Bauart M62

questions.notes: The nickname came from the loud exhaust of the first, unsilenced delivery series. The core answer is 'a (Soviet diesel) locomotive'.

timeline.labelEn: Gaius Appuleius Diocles, Roman charioteer who won almost 36 million sesterces
timeline.labelDe: Gaius Appuleius Diocles, römischer Wagenlenker, der fast 36 Millionen Sesterzen gewann

questions.notes: Diocles (born 104, died after 146/147) won about 36 million sesterces; historian Peter Struck calls him the best-paid athlete of all time.
